statement: A load's compilation has the load's deadline: one that has not answered when coldLoadTimeout (cold) or storeReadTimeout (reload) since the load began is spent ends the load as a failure by the next periodic tick, a tick that throws included (a cold load fails, a reload keeps what is installed, a recompile fails closed); a queued compilation of an ended load never starts, and a revision whose compilation timed out and still runs is not compiled again while it runs. A recompile that does not answer within its deadline leaves the document's validity under the new platform document unknown, so it fails closed; one the full compile queue refuses is a matter of capacity, and keeps what is installed for at most coldLoadTimeout since its load began (SNP-4).
guards: runtime:SnapshotCompileDeadlineTest#a cold load whose compilation never returns fails at the tick after its deadline, and holds one thread
runtime:SnapshotCompileDeadlineTest#a reload whose compilation never returns keeps what is installed once its budget is spent
runtime:SnapshotCompileDeadlineTest#a reload whose compilation never returns is reported, by key and revision, until it returns
runtime:SnapshotCompileDeadlineTest#a fail-closed tenant is refused past its lag bound while a newer revision does not compile in time
spring-boot:SnapshotHealthIndicatorTest#health names a newer revision that did not compile in time, by key and revision
runtime:SnapshotCompileDeadlineTest#a compilation still queued when its load times out never starts
